clubs.tacticsWhy: Lega Serie A data after 5 matchdays (Fantacalcio, 28 Sep): Milan are last of 20 for 'Direct Speed' (1.29), 2nd for sequences of 10+ passes (92) and possession duration (12.98 s), and 3rd for possession and pass accuracy, so tempo 1 and passing 2. Possession is 60.5% (3rd, Calcio d'Angolo/FotMob) and 51–69% in every league match. Crosses rank 10th, so width 3; the width comes from wing-backs Chukwueze and Estupiñán. Shots are only 12.8 per match (14th) against the best conversion rate (15.6%), and xG was 0.11 at Juventus, so style 'normal'. No PPDA or line-height data was found, so press 3 and line 3 are neutral estimates. setAtt and setDef are placeholders (no source).
clubs.desc: Milan spiller en 3-4-2-1 med meget boldbesiddelse og en langsom, tålmodig opbygning, hvor wingbackerne giver bredde, og de to offensive midtbanespillere bag angriberen skal skabe chancerne.
uncertain: Gabbia (1 league start of 6) went off injured after 19 min and is now out with a thigh injury until late October (FotMob). De Winter (#5, 5 starts) is the usual centre-back.

Modrić (#14, 4 starts) was benched after international duty. Musah also has 4 starts, so I kept the latest XI. A more 'current typical' XI would have De Winter for Gabbia and possibly Modrić for Musah.

Saelemaekers (#56) is injured until late October; Moreira replaced him.
Kit: home red/black stripes, red chosen. The away kit is white (acmilan.com, from a search summary; the page was not opened). Press, line and set pieces have no source.
